messages:
Aisha Patel: Heads up 1: we have a backlog affecting indexing for new tenant imports between 09:45-10:20 PDT. Need a customer-friendly update + quick mitigation steps. Keep it short.
Maria Gomez: I'll draft a concise note. Include: status, what to expect, manual reindex steps, assurance about data safety, and a goodwill gesture.
Josh Lee: Workaround snippet: `Console > Indexes > Reindex` and API tip: `POST /v1/indexes/:id/reindex` for programmatic triggers.
Samir Khan: Infra update? Rolling fix started at 10:35 PDT.
csops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout-1127 started at 2025-04-02T17:35:12Z, nodes updated: 4/10.
Liu Wei: Also flag renewal-risk customers who were onboarded in that window - CS ops should get a list so AMs can proactively reach out.
Maria Gomez: Draft: `Hi there 1, were processing a backlog that affected some new tenant imports created between 09:450:20 PDT. Engineers deployed a fix and backlog processing is underway; we expect catch-up within ~3 hours. If you need immediate access to newly ingested documents, trigger a manual reindex in Console > Indexes > Reindex or call the API: POST /v1/indexes/:id/reindex. No customer data was exposed or modified. As a courtesy well add a one-time credit equal to one day of ingestion charges and offer a complimentary 1:1 onboarding coaching session to help ensure your integration is healthy. Reply "coach" or book: https://cal.redwood.com/cs-onboard. For urgent issues contact cs@redwood.ai.`
Aisha Patel: Swap in "complimentary 1:1 onboarding coaching session" (good). Add a one-question feedback link after send: https://tiny.redwood.com/cs-feedback (Yes/No).
Jen O'Neill: I'll send targeted email templates for ARR>50k accounts once Maria posts final copy. Use subject: "Update: Indexing backlog resolved for recent imports"
Samir Khan: deploy-bot update: rollout-1127 nodes updated: 10/10, status: success at 2025-04-02T17:40:05Z. Backlog processing rate doubled post-fix. Projection: catch-up by 13:30 PDT.
Maria Gomez: Sending outbound now to affected tenants and creating an Intercom campaign for the impacted segment. I'll paste Intercom campaign id and outbound text here once sent.
Josh Lee: After send, capture responses to the feedback link and add results to tenant-health/impact-2025-04. Also add a quick column for "opted into coach".
Liu Wei: I'll pull the list of impacted tenants and flag renewal cohort; tagging AMs for high-risk customers.
csops-bot: intercom-bot: campaign-created id=IC-20250402-47 by Maria Gomez.
Maria Gomez: Outbound posted to Intercom (IC-20250402-47) and sent to enterprise list via email. Final copy below: "Hi — we identified a short processing backlog for new tenant imports created 09:45-10:20 PDT. Engineers delivered a fix; processing is catching up and we expect full completion within ~3 hours. If you need immediate access, trigger a manual reindex in Console > Indexes > Reindex or via API: POST /v1/indexes/:id/reindex. No customer data was exposed or modified. We're adding a one-time credit equal to one day of ingestion charges and offering a complimentary 1:1 onboarding coaching session. Reply 'coach' or book: https://cal.redwood.com/cs-onboard. For urgent help: cs@redwood.ai"
Aisha Patel: Thanks. Campaign id saved. Maria: please drop the feedback tally and list of coached opt-ins here when available; we'll close the loop with AMs.
Samir Khan: Confirmed credits queued for posting; will update when posted.
Josh Lee: Early feedback link responses: 18 Yes, 6 No (first 24 mins) 1. I'll push full report into tenant-health doc and tag owners.
Aisha Patel: Great work. Closing thread after credits confirmed + feedback summary. :handshake:
